title: The Sealed Nectar (Ar-Raheeq Al-Makhtum)
description: A complete authoritative biography of the Prophet Muhammad (S.A.W.) which was awarded first prize by the Muslim World League. It provides an authentic and detailed account of the life of the Prophet.

title: Tafsir ibn Kathir (Abridged)
description: One of the most comprehensive and popular explanations of the Holy Qur'an, presenting authentic narration-based interpretations of key Islamic scriptures.

title: Calculus: Early Transcendentals
description: Stewart's Calculus: Early Transcendentals series is the top-seller in the world because of its problem-solving focus, mathematical precision and accuracy, and outstanding examples.

title: Introduction to Algorithms
description: A comprehensive guide to the modern study of computer algorithms, covering a broad range of algorithms in depth, yet making their design and analysis accessible to all levels of readers.

title: The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People
description: A business and self-help book that presents a principle-centered approach for solving personal and professional problems, outlining seven habits to achieve effectiveness.

title: The Power of Habit
description: An investigation into the science of habit formation and change, explaining how habits exist, how they work, and how they can be transformed to reshape our lives.

title: Clean Code: A Handbook of Agile Software Craftsmanship
description: A must-read for any software developer, this book details best practices for writing clean, readable, and maintainable code with realistic case studies and code refactoring examples.

title: JavaScript: The Good Parts
description: An essential guide that isolates the good parts of JavaScript, helping developers write cleaner, more elegant, and less error-prone code.

title: Charlotte's Web
description: A tender novel of friendship, love, life, and death that has been cherished by generations of readers. It tells the story of a pig named Wilbur and his devoted spider friend Charlotte.

title: The Little Prince
description: A beautiful and philosophical tale about a young prince who visits various planets in space, addressing themes of loneliness, friendship, love, and loss.

title: A Brief History of Time
description: A landmark book in science writing by one of the world's great theoretical physicists, exploring the origins and evolution of the universe and key concepts of cosmology.

title: The Diary of a Young Girl
description: The writings from the Dutch-language diary kept by Anne Frank while she was in hiding for two years with her family during the Nazi occupation of the Netherlands.
